about: Public copy of the live promotion-gate flag (PROMOTION-GATE.json): numbers only, no seeds or task ids. heldout = the rule the gate runs now (heldout.cfg(flag)); legacy top-level keys apply only when heldout is off. heldout.baseline = prior-v1: the round rule is heldout.prior_v1 (priors/baseline_v1.py); the ivw-v2 keys (n, k_cand, sigma_run*, min_kept) apply only when baseline is not prior-v1.
